title: Trap-Quenched Matter-Wave Optics in Space
summary: Dual-species atomic sources in space promise to be the testbed for a multitude of searches in quantum gas physics such as a precise test of the Universality of Free Fall (UFF), few-body physics, cold molecules and quantum bubbles. These experiments demand exquisite control over the expansion energies of both condensed ensembles as well as over their differential center-of-mass dynamics. We propose a trap-quenched collimation technique featuring in-trap excitations of collective modes compatible with state-of-the-art atom-chip setups.
